subject: Procurement playbook draft & next steps — NovaPay onboarding
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@novapay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement playbook draft & next steps — NovaPay onboarding

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — great context on NovaPay's volume profile and procurement timeline. Attached is a draft "Procurement Playbook" (MAP) that breaks out the vendor-onboarding milestones we discussed and proposed owners.

High-level milestones (draft):
- Sales SOW + signature (Owner: Priya / Redwood legal) — target: Jul 20
- Procurement vendor registration in Coupa (Owner: NovaPay / Mark Ellis) — target: Jul 24
- W-9 + banking details (Owner: NovaPay) — target: Jul 24
- PO issuance / payment terms confirmation (Owner: NovaPay procurement) — target: Jul 28
- Test integration / minimal verification (Owner: Redwood eng / NovaPay) — target: Aug 2
- Go-live (Owner: both) — target: Aug 5

Dependencies: Coupa onboarding (if NovaPay uses Coupa vs Ariba), internal finance approvals, legal redlines.

Please confirm: 1) whether procurement uses Coupa or Ariba; 2) procurement contact to own vendor registration; and 3) if the Jul 30 target close date we mentioned still looks feasible or if you prefer August.

Next steps: I'll update the MAP and share v2 after you confirm procurement contact. Sharing HubSpot deal and a shared Drive copy here:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
- Drive (MAP v1): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abc

Attachments: MAP_Procurement_Playbook_NovaPay_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@novapay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement playbook draft & next steps — NovaPay onboarding

Thanks Priya — useful layout. A few quick notes:
- NovaPay uses Coupa (not Ariba).
- Procurement lead for vendor registration is Mark Ellis (mark.ellis@novapay.com). I'll loop him in.
- I've attached a quick vendor info packet that our procurement team likes to have up front.

On timelines: internal approvals will take us a few extra days. Could we move the close to target Aug 2? PO issuance typically comes after vendor registration + W-9/banking verification.

Attachments: NovaPay_Vendor_Info.pdf; I will forward completed forms from Mark once he starts the Coupa workflow.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Jones
Head of Partnerships | NovaPay
samantha.jones@novapay.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@novapay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement playbook draft & next steps — NovaPay onboarding

Samantha — great, thanks for confirming Coupa and for the vendor packet. I've updated the MAP to reflect Coupa as the vendor system and pushed the target close to Aug 2 per your note. New draft attached (v2) — key changes:
- Vendor registration path: Coupa steps added and owner set to Mark Ellis (NovaPay)
- Dates: PO and go-live windows shifted ~1 week
- Added a short "finance checklist" section listing W-9, ACH banking, and invoice remit details we need before PO.

Proposed meeting: quick procurement sync with Mark and our finance ops on Thu Jul 15 at 10:00am PT to walk the Coupa flow and required artifacts. Does that work for you & Mark?

Attachments: MAP_Procurement_Playbook_NovaPay_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Priya
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement playbook draft & next steps — NovaPay onboarding

Looping in a short procurement checklist from finance/legal side. Priya — thanks for driving the MAP. A couple of internal asks before we join the Coupa session:
- Confirm deal_id for finance: DEAL-2026-1178 (we'll use this on the PO)
- Legal: if Mark's procurement team sends any contract redlines, route to Marissa for a quick review; we should avoid expanding commercial terms.
- Finance ops (Rohan) will open the vendor onboarding request in our internal Coupa instance once we have W-9 + bank stub. Rohan, can you flag any missing fields we should pre-fill?

Attach: Redwood_Coupa_Onboarding_Guide.pdf (internal reference). Priya, if NovaPay can provide W-9 and ACH stub ahead of the meeting that will speed PO issuance.

Thanks — A

--
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
